$comment: Dated aliases of sf-inline-editor for the shim (stands/18-aliases-ci/alias.mjs, standard §16 item 20). mode: same-detail (the shim sends the new and the old name), split / detail-adds (a detail adapter, refused by the shim), attribute-and-property, method, property, manifest-only (the DOM name does not change), host-attribute (no shim), retired. These events are sent on the edited element, which carries no shim: core/js/composition/inline-editor.mjs sends each former name itself, with its former detail.
